name: music_library_cue_handoff
title: Carry a music range through the library
description: App-only durable handoff from a Timeline music range to the account Music Library. Open stores revision and elastic range facts in a server receipt; apply revalidates them and replaces the track through music_cue_mutate. A changed Episode returns a reviewable draft instead of placing stale music.

action.description: One action: {type:"open", episode_id, music_id, expected_revision, return_to?, idempotency_key}; {type:"read", handoff_id}; or {type:"apply", handoff_id, library_entry_id, idempotency_key}.
